items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: And he called us up and say, 'Come on, listen to this.' We say, 'Man, that's beautiful.'

ctx.x: Okay, that was the Casa Loma Band that he took over.

Yeah. He say, 'I'm looking for a sound, you know. I haven't got it yet.' And he got it. He finally got it. Like it was in the picture. He was looking for something, and he found it. And he called us up and say, 'Come on, listen to this.' We say, 'Man, that's beautiful.' But in the meantime, we were working with Jack, (Unaudible) -- Robbins' music -- Shapiro
